mandatory_fields.requirement: The retail sale price of the package shall clearly indicate that it is the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes in Indian currency (e.g. 'MRP Rs. xx.xx' or '₹ xx.xx (inclusive of all taxes)'). Price must be in Indian currency. No individual stickers may alter or cover the MRP except for reducing the price. Selling above printed MRP, dual MRP on identical goods, or smudging/altering MRP is strictly prohibited.
mandatory_fields.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) & Section 36(2) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Rule 6(1)(e), Rule 2(m), and Rule 18(2), 18(2A), 18(5) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
mandatory_fields.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 for non-declaration or improper declaration under Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (Compounding under Rule 32A Table: ₹5,000 for retailers/wholesalers, ₹25,000 for manufacturers/importers); Fine up to ₹2,000 for selling above MRP under Section 36(2) (Compounding under Rule 32A Table: ₹10,000 for retailers/wholesalers, ₹50,000 for manufacturers/importers); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32 where no punishment is provided in the Act.
mandatory_fields.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (and for subsequent offences, fine from ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both); Fine up to ₹5,000 for selling above MRP under Section 36(2); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32.

mandatory_fields.requirement: The net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number of the commodity contained in the package shall be mentioned. Tare weight of wrappers and packaging material must be excluded. Units must be in standard metric SI units: gram (g) for < 1kg, kilogram (kg) for >= 1kg; millilitre (ml) for < 1L, litre (L) for >= 1L; centimetre (cm) for < 1m, metre (m) for >= 1m. For items sold by number: number, unit, piece, pair, or set (symbol N or U). Prohibited terms include dozen, gross, and misleading qualifiers like 'approximate', 'when packed' (unless listed in Third Schedule). Net quantity deficiency must not exceed Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) specified in First Schedule Table I and Table II.
mandatory_fields.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Rule 6(1)(c), Rule 11, Rule 12, Rule 13, and First Schedule of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
mandatory_fields.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(c), Rule 11, Rule 12, Rule 13, First Schedule
mandatory_fields.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 under Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (Compounding sum under Rule 32A Table: ₹5,000 for retailers/wholesalers, ₹25,000 for manufacturers/importers); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32 where no punishment is provided in the Act.
mandatory_fields.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (for subsequent offence: fine from ₹50,000 up to ₹1,00,000, or imprisonment for a term up to 1 year, or both); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32.

mandatory_fields.requirement: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured shall be mentioned on the package (the words 'or pre-packed or imported' omitted w.e.f. 01.10.2022 vide GSR 226(E)). Month and year may be expressed either in words, or by numerals indicating the month and the year, or by both (Explanation I). Exemptions: bidi, incense sticks, or domestic LPG cylinder (14.2kg or 5kg) marketed by public sector undertakings (Rule 6(1) Proviso A).
mandatory_fields.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Rule 6(1)(d) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

mandatory_fields.requirement: If a package contains a commodity which may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, the 'best before or use by the date, month and year' shall also be mentioned on the label. 'Best before' signifies the end of the period under stated storage conditions during which the product remains fully marketable and retains any specific tacit or express claimed qualities (and beyond which the commodity may still be safe for consumption). 'Use by Date' signifies the end of the estimated period under stated storage conditions after which the product shall not have the quality attributes normally expected by consumers and should not be regarded as marketable. Exemption: does not apply if a provision in this regard is made in any other law (e.g., FSSAI).
mandatory_fields.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Rule 6(1)(da) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
mandatory_fields.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 under Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (Compounding sum under Rule 32A Table: ₹5,000 for retailers/wholesalers, ₹25,000 for manufacturers/importers); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32 where no punishment is provided in the Act.

mandatory_fields.field_label: Name and Address of Manufacturer, Packer or Importer
mandatory_fields.requirement: The name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer, and for any imported package the name and address of the importer shall be mentioned. 'Complete address' means the postal address at which the factory is situated or company/firm is registered, street name, premises number, city, State, and Postal Index Number (PIN) Code so that a consumer can identify and locate the entity (Rule 10 Explanation 1). If a name appears without qualifying words 'manufactured by' or 'packed by', it is presumed to be the manufacturer (Rule 6(1) Explanation I). Brand owners/marketers are deemed responsible as manufacturers (Explanation II). Name must be the actual corporate name or registered business name in India (Rule 10(2)).
mandatory_fields.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Rule 6(1)(a) and Rule 10 of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
mandatory_fields.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 under Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (Compounding sum under Rule 32A Table: ₹5,000 for retailers/wholesalers, ₹25,000 for manufacturers/importers); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32 where no punishment is provided in the Act.

mandatory_fields.requirement: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address of the person who can be or the office which can be contacted, in case of consumer complaints (Rule 6(2)). Numerical and letter heights must satisfy minimum height requirements on the principal display panel under Rule 7 Table-I.

mandatory_fields.requirement: The name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported products shall be mentioned on the package (Rule 6(1)(aa)). Under Rule 6(9), it is permissible to affix a label on imported packages for making the mandatory declarations required under these rules.
mandatory_fields.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Rule 6(1)(aa) & Rule 6(9) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
mandatory_fields.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 under Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (Compounding sum under Rule 32A Table: ₹5,000 for retailers/wholesalers, ₹25,000 for manufacturers/importers); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32 where no punishment is provided in the Act.

mandatory_fields.requirement: The unit sale price in rupees, rounded off to the nearest two decimal places, shall be declared on every pre-packaged commodity in the following manner: (i) per gram where net quantity is less than one kilogram, and per kilogram where net quantity is more than one kilogram; (ii) per centimetre where net length is less than one metre, and per metre where net length is more than one metre; (iii) per millilitre where net volume is less than one litre, and per litre where net volume is more than one litre; (iv) per number or unit if any item is sold by number or unit. Exemption: Not required for pre-packaged commodities in which retail sale price is equal to the unit sale price. Alcoholic beverages and spirits are governed by State Excise laws (Rule 6(11) as substituted vide GSR 226(E) dated 28.03.2022 w.e.f. 01.10.2022).

mandatory_fields.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (for subsequent offence: fine from ₹50,000 up to ₹1,00,000, or imprisonment for a term up to 1 year, or both); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32.

mandatory_fields.requirement: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package and in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product shall be mentioned on the package (Rule 6(1)(b)).

mandatory_fields.requirement: Red/brown dot for non-veg or green dot for veg on cosmetics, soaps, and toiletries. Mandatory 'GM' mark at top of Principal Display Panel for Genetically Modified items (Rule 6(7) & 6(8)).

mandatory_fields.requirement: E-commerce digital marketplaces must display all Rule 6(1) mandatory declarations (MRP, Net Quantity, Country of Origin, Manufacturer details, Expiry/Best Before) on product listing pages prior to consumer purchase (Rule 6(10)).

mandatory_fields.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (for subsequent offence: fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year).

mandatory_fields.field_label: Mandatory Font Size & Principal Display Panel (PDP) Scaling
mandatory_fields.requirement: Numeral and letter heights must scale to PDP area: Area <= 50 cm2: 1.0mm; 50-100 cm2: 1.5mm; 100-500 cm2: 2.5mm; 500-2500 cm2: 4.0mm; >2500 cm2: 6.0mm (Rule 7 & Table-I).

mandatory_fields.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009; or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32.

mandatory_fields.requirement: Declarations must be in English or Hindi (Devnagri script), contrasting conspicuously against background with required surround spacing around net quantity (Rules 8 & 9).

mandatory_fields.field_label: Market Practices & Retailer Compliance (Overcharging, Dual MRP, Weighing Receipts)
mandatory_fields.requirement: Selling pre-packaged commodities above declared MRP is strictly prohibited under Rule 18(1). Printing or declaring different MRPs on identical pre-packaged goods for different locations/buyers is prohibited under Rule 18(2). All GST-registered retail stores dealing in weight/measure goods must maintain Class-III electronic weighing scales with free printed consumer receipts under Rule 18(7).
mandatory_fields.act_section: Section 18 read with Section 36(2) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Rule 18(1), 18(2), 18(7) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
mandatory_fields.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹2,000 for retail dealer under Section 36(2); Compounding fee under Rule 32A: ₹10,000 for retailers/wholesalers, ₹50,000 for manufacturers/importers.
mandatory_fields.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹5,000 under Section 36(2) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009.

mandatory_fields.requirement: Every manufacturer, packer, or importer must register premises with the Director/Controller of Legal Metrology within 90 days of business commencement (Rule 27-30).
mandatory_fields.act_section: Section 18 read with Section 37 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009; Rule 27, 28, 29, 30 of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
mandatory_fields.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹4,000 under Section 37 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 read with Rule 32.
mandatory_fields.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹10,000 under Section 37 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009.

improvement_notice.governing_rules: Rule 20(1)(ii), Rule 23(1) of PCR 2011 read with Section 15 and Section 18 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009

spot_panchanama.purpose: Executed contemporaneous on-spot record drawn at time of inspection/seizure in presence of independent witnesses. Response deadline is a configurable default.

rules.requirement: The provisions of this chapter shall not apply to: (a) packages of commodities containing quantity of more than 25 kilogram or 25 litre; (b) cement, fertilizer and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kilogram; and (c) packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers (substituted vide GSR 629(E) w.e.f. 1.1.2018).

rules.requirement: No person shall pre-pack or cause or permit to be pre-packed any commodity for sale, distribution or delivery unless the package bears thereon or on a label securely affixed thereto, such declarations as are required under these rules. Grouped promotional packages must each comply with Rule 6.

rules.field_label: Voluntary Barcode / QR Code / e-code Declarations
rules.requirement: Nothing shall preclude manufacturer or packer or importer to declare barcode, GTIN, QR Code, e-code for net quantity assurance, and logos of Government schemes such as Swachh Bharat Mission (inserted vide GSR 629(E) w.e.f. 1.1.2018).
rules.act_section: Section 18 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.penalty_first_offence: N/A - Permissible additional declarations
rules.penalty_second_offence: N/A

rules.chapter: CHAPTER II - PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO PACKAGES INTENDED FOR RETAIL SALE
rules.field_label: GM Food & Veg / Non-Veg Origin Symbols
rules.requirement: Packages containing GM food must bear 'GM' at top of PDP. Packages containing soaps, shampoos, tooth pastes and cosmetics/toiletries must bear red/brown dot for non-vegetarian origin or green dot for vegetarian origin at top of PDP.
rules.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 under Section 36(1); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32
rules.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 36(1); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32

rules.chapter: CHAPTER II - PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO PACKAGES INTENDED FOR RETAIL SALE
rules.requirement: An E-Commerce entity shall ensure mandatory declarations specified in sub-rule (1), except month and year of manufacture/packing, are displayed on digital network used for e-commerce transactions.
rules.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 under Section 36(1); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32
rules.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 36(1); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32

rules.chapter: CHAPTER II - PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO PACKAGES INTENDED FOR RETAIL SALE
rules.requirement: Unit sale price in rupees rounded off to nearest two decimal places shall be declared on every pre-packaged commodity as: per g (<1kg) / per kg (>1kg); per cm (<1m) / per m (>1m); per ml (<1L) / per L (>1L); per number/unit. Exempt when retail sale price equals unit sale price (substituted vide GSR 226(E) w.e.f. 01.10.2022).
rules.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 under Section 36(1) (Compounding: ₹5,000 retailers / ₹25,000 manufacturers); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32
rules.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 36(1) (Subsequent: fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year or both); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32

rules.chapter: CHAPTER II - PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO PACKAGES INTENDED FOR RETAIL SALE
rules.field_label: Principal Display Panel and Font Height Requirements
rules.requirement: Principal display panel (PDP) area calculation (rectangular = H x W; cylindrical = 40% H x circumference). Minimum height of numerals and letters: Area < 50 sq cm: 1.0mm (2.0mm blown/molded); 50-100 sq cm: 1.5mm (3.0mm); 100-500 sq cm: 2.5mm (4.0mm); 500-2500 sq cm: 4.0mm (6.0mm); > 2500 sq cm: 6.0mm (6.0mm). Width must not be less than 1/3 height (except '1', 'i', 'I', 'l').
rules.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 under Section 36(1); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32
rules.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 36(1); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32

rules.chapter: CHAPTER II - PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO PACKAGES INTENDED FOR RETAIL SALE
rules.field_label: Placement, Contrast and Language of Declarations
rules.requirement: Declarations must appear on PDP with surrounding clear space (above/below equal to numeral height; left/right twice numeral height). Numerals of MRP and net quantity must contrast conspicuously with background. Must be in Hindi in Devanagari script or in English (additional languages permitted).
rules.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 under Section 36(1); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32
rules.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 36(1); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32

rules.chapter: CHAPTER II - PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO PACKAGES INTENDED FOR RETAIL SALE
rules.requirement: If package contains commodity which may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, 'best before or use by the date, month and year' shall be mentioned on label.
rules.act_section: Section 18(1) read with Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 under Section 36(1) (Compounding: ₹5,000 retailers / ₹25,000 manufacturers); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32
rules.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 36(1) (Subsequent: fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year or both); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32

rules.chapter: CHAPTER II - PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO PACKAGES INTENDED FOR RETAIL SALE
rules.field_label: Retail/Wholesale Price Compliance and GST Weighing Instrument
rules.requirement: No wholesale dealer, retail dealer or importer shall sell/display non-compliant package. No sale at price exceeding MRP. No dual MRP. No alteration/smudging of MRP. Retailers under GST dealing in packaged goods by weight/volume must maintain Class III electronic weighing machine with smallest division <= 1g and receipt facility for free consumer verification.
rules.act_section: Section 18 & Section 36(2) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹2,000 under Section 36(2) (Compounding: ₹10,000 retailers / ₹50,000 manufacturers); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32
rules.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹5,000 under Section 36(2); or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32

rules.chapter: CHAPTER V - EXEMPTIONS
rules.field_label: Exemptions in Respect of Certain Packages
rules.requirement: Nothing in PCR 2011 applies to: (a) Net weight/measure <= 10g or 10ml (not applicable to tobacco); (b) Fast food items packed by hotel/restaurant; (c) Formulations covered under DPCO 2013 (medical devices declared as drugs not exempt); (e) Thread sold in coil to handloom weavers.
rules.act_section: Section 18 & Section 52 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.penalty_first_offence: N/A - Exemption provision
rules.penalty_second_offence: N/A

rules.chapter: CHAPTER VI - REGISTRATION OF MANUFACTURERS, PACKERS AND IMPORTERS
rules.field_label: Mandatory Registration of Manufacturers, Packers and Importers
rules.requirement: Every manufacturer, packer, or importer must apply for registration within 90 days of commencement or beginning pre-packing with fee of ₹500 (Rule 27). Shorter address permissible upon approval (Rule 28). Register maintained by Director/Controller open to public without fee (Rule 29).
rules.act_section: Section 37 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 read with Rule 27 of PCR 2011
rules.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹4,000 under Rule 32(1) for contravention of rules 27 and 28; or penalty under Section 37 of Act (fine up to ₹25,000)
rules.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹50,000 under Section 37 of Act; or fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32

rules.chapter: CHAPTER VII - GENERAL & SCHEDULES
rules.field_label: General Penalty, Compounding Sums, and Schedules
rules.requirement: Rule 31: Advertisement mentioning MRP must mention net quantity/number in same font size. Rule 32: Fine up to ₹5,000 for contravention of rules where no punishment is provided. Rule 32A: Table of compounding sums (Section 29: ₹2,000/₹10,000; Section 36(1): ₹5,000/₹25,000; Section 36(2): ₹10,000/₹50,000). First Schedule: MPE; Third Schedule: 'when packed' commodities; Fourth Schedule: exceptions to Rule 12(2); Fifth Schedule: sampling; Sixth Schedule: testing procedures; Seventh Schedule: Forms A & B.
rules.act_section: Section 18, 29, 36, 48, 52 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.penalty_first_offence: Fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32
rules.penalty_second_offence: Fine up to ₹5,000 under Rule 32
